recognize_zh: 淋巴球門控的流式雙參數圖：紅色主要族群位於右下象限，CD38 陽性、CD19 陰性，另有一部分紅點拖向 CD38 弱至陰性；上方零星藍點為 CD19 陽性 B 細胞；顯示擴增族群不是 B 細胞，CD38 本身不具細胞系專一性，需搭配 T 細胞標記判讀。
features: Two-parameter dot plot gated on lymphocytes: CD19 PE-Cy7 (y-axis) vs CD38 APC-H7 (x-axis)
Dominant red population in Q4: moderate to bright CD38, CD19 negative
Smear of red events extending leftward into CD38 dim/negative region (Q3)
Sparse light-blue CD19-positive B cells in Q1/Q2
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on lymphocytes shows CD19 (y-axis) versus CD38 (x-axis). The predominant population (red) is CD19-negative and expresses moderate to bright CD38, with a subset trailing into dim to negative CD38 expression. Only rare CD19-positive B cells (blue) are present. CD38 is an activation marker without lineage specificity; the absence of CD19 excludes a B-cell or plasmablastic population and, with CD3 and TCR gamma/delta expression on companion plots, supports an expanded T-cell population consistent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic plasma cells are also CD19-negative but show very bright CD38 with CD138 and lack surface CD3, whereas this population is CD3+ T cells with moderate CD38.

ddx.dx: CD38+ B-cell neoplasm (e.g., CLL with CD38 expression)
ddx.vs: B-cell neoplasms co-express CD19 and would fall in the upper right quadrant, not the CD19-negative quadrant seen here.
Activated reactive T cells may also be CD38+ CD19-, so this plot cannot distinguish them; clonal TCR rearrangement and persistence are required.
